name: Riven Trench
introDiscord:
The trench is split by wounds so deep they resemble cracks through the
world itself.

Trench-Rending Worms have made those cracks deeper.
introTwitch:
The trench is split by wounds so deep they resemble cracks through the
world itself.

Trench-Rending Worms have made those cracks deeper.

riven-trench-approach.prompt: Three routes cross the fractured seabed.

left.message:
One Berry sits beside Shizuki's warning:

'Crack was already huge.

Worm made bigger.

I am contributing by touching NOTHING.'

right.message: A navigator's chest rests inside the fracture.

forward.message: A Trench-Rending Worm erupts through the seabed.

riven-trench-depths.prompt: The cracks spread beneath enormous bones.

left.message: A Worm tears through an old Leviathan scar.

right.message:
Shizuki's medicine:

'Ground-related emergency kit.

This region has expanded definition of ground.'

forward.message: A strongbox lies inside a fresh split.

left.message: Star Candies rest beneath a fractured scale.

right.message: A Trench-Rending Worm crosses the chasm wall.

forward.message:
Shizuki's bottle reads:

'If crack gets any larger, it becomes destination.

Leaving now.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative and appreciate the logic.

bossPromptDiscord:
Split-Sea Chasm widens.

The stone itself begins moving.

Something below is not merely living inside the fracture.

It is creating it.

Use /yes to enter the Chasm or /no to preserve the current number of
pieces the seabed is in.
bossPromptTwitch:
Split-Sea Chasm widens.

The stone itself begins moving.

Something below is not merely living inside the fracture.

It is creating it.

Use !yes to enter the Chasm or !no to preserve the current number of
pieces the seabed is in.
bossRetreatText: You retreat onto relatively intact terrain.

boss.revealText:
The chasm tears wider as an enormous Worm rises.

Worldscar Worm reveals itself!

completionText:
The Worldscar disappears beneath the trench.

The fracture stops growing.

For now.
